articles.title: Pahoehoe Rope — Dance (Classic)
articles.summary: Glossy black base with flowing molten orange-red rope-like flame bands; classic hot-rod flame pattern in bright lava colours. A black car swarming with fiery orange wavy lines; reads as flowing lava rope or marbled fire, high contrast, busy and bright.
articles.what: Procedural flame finish: pahoehoe rope structure with the dance spec mode (classic palette). FRACTURED FLAMES. Up close: Wavy contour bands of glowing orange and yellow-orange, 10-25px wide, running side by side with black gaps like a topo map or lava rope, folding into loops and eye-shaped whorls. Bands are soft-edged with brighter yellow-hot spots along them. Roughly half orange, half black. From a distance: A black car swarming with fiery orange wavy lines; reads as flowing lava rope or marbled fire, high contrast, busy and bright. Measured spec (average): metal 218, roughness 40, coat 237. Shine: gloss. Metal: full. It brings its own colours.
when: Fits: stock car, gt / sports car, show car.
how: This finish is not listed in the Base Material picker, so you cannot pick it there.
Open the AI copilot (the ✦ AI button, bottom right) and ask for it by name, for example "put Pahoehoe Rope — Dance (Classic) on the hood".
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood, roof and sides: whole-car pattern works at any size
Skip small trim where the bands look like noise
Bands alternate orange and black at number stroke width, so numbers need a plate; white numbers on a black plate read best.
None: the bands are already busy
Pairs well with: black, chrome, yellow, deep red.
Not listed in the picker: ask the AI copilot for it by name.
pitfalls: Not classic hot-rod flame licks: no pointed tips, it is a contour-band field
Not a single plume like Dragon Jet or Eruption Column: the bands cover the whole panel
Avoid: numbers over flame crests, next to other loud finishes.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 218 (true metallic), roughness 40 (high gloss), clearcoat 237 (almost no clearcoat).
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: numbers over flame crests, next to other loud finishes.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: none: the bands are already busy; avoid adding anything fine
